blocks.text: Finding 1 (ADOPT, priority 2) — unbounded per-socket chat transcript

content.value: Filed: task-a9adc82f820db065 (parent task-30564ed509eb2997).

NAMED FAILURE MODE: the Studio Claude chat loads a session's ENTIRE message history into a per-socket list assign with no cap, and re-renders every row through the paper engine synchronously on the LiveView process at session open.

blocks.value:
studio_chat.ex:128   list_messages/1 = Repo.all with NO limit
chat_live.ex:3520    replay_messages/2 maps that uncapped list through
                     replay_message/2 -> paper-engine markdown render (D7),
                     O(n) synchronous CPU at open, blocks the reopen
chat_live.ex:1186,   @messages grows via '++ [message]' every turn
  1387,3465,3717
chat_live.ex:2184    render calls group_agent_rows(@messages), which walks
                     all messages 3x (spawns map, children reduce, flat_map)
                     on EVERY @messages change -> O(n) per turn, O(n^2)/session

content.value: COST: a long agent chat (Claude Code sessions routinely emit thousands of tool/assistant/user rows) holds O(n) BEAM memory per connected tab for the session lifetime — tool-result rows carry large code/text payloads, conservatively 1-5KB/row, so 1k rows is roughly 1-5MB per socket, multiplied by tabs and concurrent sessions. Plus O(n) paper-engine render blocking reopen, plus O(n) group_agent_rows recompute per turn. Many concurrent long sessions raise an OOM/availability risk.

FIX MENU (builder's call): (1) cap list_messages to last N with a lazy 'load older' page; and/or (2) assign_async the transcript hydration so the shell renders first — the tree has ZERO assign_async today, this is the signal; and/or (3) memoize group_agent_rows. Streams is an AWKWARD fit because group_agent_rows GROUPS consecutive rows into agent blocks (streams render one DOM node per item) — do NOT force a streams rewrite; cap+async is the cheaper win. The fix task owns the protective test (query test asserting a LIMIT) and the before/after measurement (reopen wall-time and :erlang.external_size on @messages at N=2000).

api_tester_live Task.async (api_tester_live.ex:333-378): exemplary hand-rolled async — Process.demonitor(ref, [:flush]) on BOTH the result message and the :DOWN, plus a stray-ref fallthrough clause. Correctly handles crash/cancel; converting to assign_async/async_result would be fashion, not improvement. Rejected conversion.

chat_live plan-publish (chat_live.ex:3861): Task.Supervisor.start_child under Barkpark.TaskSupervisor — supervised, $callers-scoped (sandbox-safe under test), never touches the socket (talks to the session PubSub topic), and wraps publish in try/rescue/catch so a crash degrades to an honest 'couldn't publish' broadcast instead of silence. Already-good.

LiveView native uploads: chat :attachments (chat_live.ex:182) accept-list + max_entries 4 + max_file_size 3MB (sized to the Anthropic per-image cap after base64 inflation); studio :image (mount.ex:271) accept-list + max_entries 1 + max_file_size 10MB. Both carry accept/entries/size limits. The studio accept-list includes .svg, but the serve path (media_controller.ex:129) collapses dangerous MIMEs to application/octet-stream with nosniff + content-disposition:attachment, defusing stored-XSS. Already-good.

Streaming collections already on streams: bulldocs_live blocks (bulldocs_live.ex:642) and studio paper_blocks (mount.ex:270). Sessions sidebar list is capped at @sidebar_cap (studio_chat.ex:101). Already-good.

AI turn execution is owned by an external GenServer subprocess (ClaudeChat.Session) streaming results over PubSub — no blocking Claude call in handle_event. Proper OTP off-process design; assign_async not needed there. Already-good.

Studio document-type list pane as a streams candidate: Content.list_documents defaults limit 100 / max 1000 (content.ex:61) and the pane re-fetches wholesale on rebuild — bounded, not unbounded-per-socket. Streams would only trim re-render churn on a <=100-row list, below the measurable-win bar. Rejected.

Forms to_form vs raw changeset: doc_to_form/2 returns a plain map() by design (content/forms.ex:34) because the Studio editor is schema-driven with dynamic fields — there is no fixed Ecto changeset/field-set to source a %Phoenix.HTML.Form{} from, so to_form buys nothing. Edits autosave via phx-change with phx-debounce (150ms slug / 500ms paper blocks), bounding the unsaved-edit window. Reconnect recovery of in-progress contenteditable keystrokes within the <=500ms debounce window is a real but low-severity, hard-to-test-statically gap; not filed. Rejected-with-reason.

Media upload default size cap: Media.upload's allowlist + size cap are config-gated OFF by default (media.ex:132) to honor the fresh-install zero-rejection invariant; the /media/upload route is write-token-gated (:media_mutate pipeline) and the 100MB Plug.Parsers length (endpoint.ex:124) is the effective ceiling. Worst case is a trusted-writer disk-fill DoS — a deliberate decision, not a defect. Rejected-with-reason.
